6825.title: Latest-state reads scan unrelated extension snapshots
6825.rootCauseOneLine: The forced partial index keys only thread and sequence; kind remains a JSON predicate evaluated while scanning newer state rows.
6825.proposedFix: Add a kind-aware index and split native-goal and extension-state seeks, retaining newest-sequence semantics. Requires a migration, so excluded from automatic simple fixes.
6825.caveats: Reproduction source and exact observations are inline per reports repository policy. Exact production stall cadence and proxy resets were not tested. Full monorepo builds stop on unrelated missing SDK runtime dist; database owner tests and typecheck pass.
